## One-off build pricing
- Website development: from ₹25,000
- AI agent or chatbot: from ₹80,000
- Full product build: from ₹1,60,000
- SEO & AI search: from ₹12,000 / month
- n8n automation build: from ₹27,000
- AI images: from ₹6,500 / batch
- AI video: from ₹9,000 / video
- Site audit & rescue: from ₹15,000
- Local SEO setup: from ₹10,000
- Advice only: ₹8,000 / hour
- Monthly retainer: quoted per scope
Model usage on AI builds is billed to the client's own API account. Copywriting, photography, domain and hosting are not included in a website build.

## Packaged automation plans (setup plus monthly support)
- Starter: ₹9,999 one-time setup, ₹1,999/month maintenance & support — Perfect for individuals, startups and small businesses.
- Business: ₹24,999 one-time setup, ₹4,999/month maintenance & support — Perfect for growing businesses that need smarter workflows and AI automation.
- Premium AI Automation: Starting at ₹49,999 custom one-time setup, ₹9,999/month maintenance & support — For businesses that need a complete custom automation ecosystem.
These are a different offer from the one-off builds above: pay once and own it, or pay a smaller setup fee plus a monthly fee and have it maintained. n8n hosting, AI API usage, email, WhatsApp and CRM subscriptions are billed separately by those providers.
